SimpleProduct:14855.faq:
How will my order be printed?

Each tote is printed on demand and blends seamlessly to the top quality polyester fabric.

How do I wash my Tote Bag?

To keep your Tote Bag looking great we recommend that you wash them using a cold wash cycle. They shouldn't be bleached or put into a tumble dryer, but you can use a dry warm iron on the reverse of the print to keep them wrinkle-free.

description.html:
Personalise these incredible Tote Bags Australia loves & give them as unique gifts to your kid's teachers or even to Mum, Grandma or yourself!

These are perfect for people who are always on the go as they're so convenient & easy to bring anywhere. Each Tote Bag has reinforced handles that can carry heavy items, like books and school supplies with ease. The handles are also long enough so they're easy to carry over your shoulder.

Made from white polyester fabric, the print is sure to be crisp & vivid & will last for years to come.

Plus, they're not only super cute, they're also easy to keep clean! Simply pop them in the washing machine when they get dirty & voila! They'll look brand new again.

Our Team prints each Tote Bag with great care & attention at our Australian design studio. Order now & it'll be at your doorstep in no time!

Tote Bag size: 38cm wide x 38cm high x 8cm deep (15" x 15" x 3")

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.

Your image cannot be smaller than 300kb or exceed 20 MB. Supported file types are ai, heic, eps, pdf, jpg, jpeg, png. You are responsible for the quality of the image that you upload. Bright Star Kids cannot be held responsible for any poor quality prints resulting from a low quality image.

The following images are NOT acceptable:

• Weapons or references to violence
• Drugs or Alcohol
• Nudity
• Celebrity images or any images you don’t have the rights to use
• Offensive Content
• Brand Logos
• Trademark or Copyright Material

You understand that any personal information you provide will be collected, used and disclosed in accordance with Bright Star Kids privacy policy. You also acknowledgement that, if the image is of or includes another person, you have obtained the consent of the other person/people for their image to be used by Bright Star Kids to create the Photo Tile.

CmsBlock:image_uploader_guide.content:
• The minimum file size is 300kb, and the maximum file size is 20mb.
  • The file formats accepted here are ai, heic, eps, pdf, jpg, jpeg, png.
  • Only one file at a time can be uploaded.
  • To upload multiple designs to be printed on one of the Photo Tiles, please group your designs into one file using Canva or Adobe Illustrator.
